info.title: SurveyCTO Server API (v1 + v2)
info.description: SurveyCTO Server REST API, merging Dobility's two published OpenAPI documents: api-v2.json (the current, comprehensive API: datasets, dataset records, form submissions, users, roles, teams, groups, workflow profiles) and api-v1.json (the legacy form-export endpoints: long/wide CSV, per-repeat-group CSV, file URL listing, and CSV linebreak settings, none of which api-v2 exposes). Both are the vendor's own OpenAPI 3.0.1 documents, committed verbatim as upstream.json (v2) and upstream-v1.json (v1); nothing here is hand-authored. A SurveyCTO server name replaces your-server; the API version segment (v1 or v2) is a credential field (apiVersion), not fixed by the adaptor.

post.description:
Returns a paginated list of records with optional filters on dataset column names, optional modifiedAt range filters in the request body (use field `modifiedAt` with operators gt, gte, lt, lte and ISO-8601 instant values), and optional field selection. Regular column filters support operators `eq` and `contains`. Pagination and ordering use the same query parameters as GET /{datasetId}/records.

**Filter index cap:** The server may create at most one filter index per distinct filtered dataset column. The total number of filter-indexed columns per dataset is limited by your license (**default 10**; your server may use a different cap). If a search would exceed that limit, the request fails with HTTP 400 and the error message lists columns that are already indexed—reuse those columns or contact support to raise the cap.

post.description:
Uploads records to a dataset from a CSV file.

**Request parts** (`multipart/form-data`):
* **`file`** — the CSV file. Required.
* **`metadata`** — optional JSON part with content type `application/json`, for example `{"uploadMode":"append"}`. Fields:
  * `uploadMode` — one of **`append`** (default; adds the rows to the existing records), **`clear`** (deletes all existing records, then inserts the uploaded rows), or **`merge`** (updates rows matching `joiningField` and inserts the rest).
  * `joiningField` — the field to match rows on. Required when `uploadMode` is `merge`, ignored otherwise.

Only the `metadata` part is read for the upload mode. Sending the mode any other way — a plain form field, a query parameter — is ignored, and the upload silently appends.

Note the accepted value for a full replacement is `clear`; `replace` is **not** accepted and currently fails with a 500 rather than a 400.

Only the `file` part is rendered below: the spec generator cannot yet publish multipart schemas.

parameters.name: datasetId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the dataset.

requestBody.description: The CSV file, plus an optional JSON metadata part selecting the upload mode. See the description for the part names and the metadata fields.

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid file type or data, or uploadMode 'merge' without a joiningField

error.message: Please specify the unique field to use for merging.

404.description: Not Found - Dataset does not exist

500.description: Internal Server Error - An unrecognized uploadMode reaches the server as an unhandled error rather than a 400

error.message: Invalid uploadMode: replace

post.description:
Returns every submission of a form as a JSON array in wide format.

**The `date` parameter is required**, despite being a query parameter: a request without it is rejected with 400. Pass `date=0` to pull all submissions, or an exclusive lower bound to pull only what is newer.

For **encrypted** forms, send the RSA private key and use **POST**: the key is a `multipart/form-data` field named **`private_key`** holding the PEM file, at most 50KB. Unencrypted forms can use GET with query parameters only. (`private_key` is listed below as a query parameter because the spec generator cannot yet express a multipart field; it is a multipart part, not a query string value.)

Two throttles apply. `date=0` requests are limited to one per licensed quiet period, and a second one inside that window is rejected with **417**. The server API does not serve parallel requests: a request that arrives while another is in flight is rejected with **409**.

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form.

parameters.name: private_key
parameters.description: For encrypted forms only: the RSA private key in PEM format, sent as a multipart form field on POST. Maximum 50KB.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Required. Exclusive lower bound on submission date for included rows (format as accepted by the server API date parser). Use 0 to pull all submissions, subject to the quiet-period throttle.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of review statuses to filter the data. Valid values include: 'approved', 'rejected'.

200.description: OK - The submissions as a JSON array in wide format

400.description: Bad Request - Missing date parameter, blank form ID, or a private key file over 50KB

error.message: File size must not exceed 50KB.
Please provide a date using the 'date' parameter.

409.description: Conflict - Another server API request is already being served; retry when it finishes

error.message: Your request was rejected because another one is currently being served; the server API does not support parallel requests, so please try again.

417.description: Expectation Failed - A date=0 (pull everything) request arrived inside the licensed quiet period following the previous one

error.message: Please wait for 240 seconds before retrying to pull all submissions for this form.

500.description: Internal Server Error - The export failed

post.description:
Use **multipart/form-data** when the form stores **encrypted** submission payloads (or whenever you must supply the key as a file). **Multipart part names:**
- **`private_key`** — RSA private key in **PEM** format (file upload). Used to decrypt submission XML and corrections; max **50KB**. For encrypted forms you should include this part so field data can be decrypted (without it, responses may only expose non-secret metadata around the encryption manifest).
- **`search`** — optional **text** part whose value is a **JSON string** (double-encoded: the part body is literal characters like `{"filters":...}`), with the same `filters` / `fields` JSON object shape as **POST** `/submissions/search`.

**Query parameters** (not multipart parts): `cursor`, `limit`, `orderBy`, `orderByDirection` — same as GET/POST search.

Non-encrypted forms: prefer **GET** `/submissions` or **POST** `/submissions/search` with `Content-Type: application/json`.

post.description:
Returns cursor-paginated submissions using a JSON request body. `filters` may reference **metadata fields only**: submissionId, reviewStatus, formDefinitionVersion, submissionDate, completionDate. Supported operators: eq, contains, gt, gte, lt, lte, in (for `in`, provide a comma-separated list in `value`; at most 100 values). `fields` selects which keys to return and may include any metadata or form data field from the form definition.

For **encrypted** forms, upload the RSA private key and send filters as multipart instead: **POST** `/api/v2/forms/{formId}/submissions` with parts **`private_key`** (PEM file) and optional **`search`** (JSON string, same shape as this endpoint's body).

post.description:
Returns a single file attached to one submission — a photo, audio recording, signature, or any other media captured with the form.

For **encrypted** forms, send the RSA private key and use **POST**: the key is a `multipart/form-data` field named **`private_key`** holding the PEM file. The server decrypts the attachment before returning it, resolving the stored `.enc` file for you. Unencrypted forms can use GET. (`private_key` is listed below as a query parameter because the spec generator cannot yet express a multipart field; it is a multipart part, not a query string value.)

The response body is the raw file bytes, with the content type of the attachment itself.

Note that an attachment which does not exist is reported as **400**, not 404.

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form.

parameters.name: instanceID
parameters.description: The submission's instance ID, as returned by the submissions endpoints.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: The attachment's filename as recorded on the submission. For encrypted forms give the plaintext name; the server resolves the stored .enc file.

parameters.name: private_key
parameters.description: For encrypted forms only: the RSA private key in PEM format, sent as a multipart form field on POST.

200.description: OK - The attachment file bytes, served with the attachment's own content type

400.description: Bad Request - Blank form ID, instance ID, or filename, or no attachment with that filename on that submission

error.message: No submission attachment was found with 'photo_1.jpg' as the filename.
No instance ID was specified.

500.description: Internal Server Error - The attachment could not be read or decrypted

post.description:
Creates a new user.

`username` and `roleId` are always required. Whether a password is required depends on `passwordOption`: with **`SET_NOW`** (the default when omitted) both `password` and `confirmPassword` are required and must match; with **`USER_SET_OWN`** the user is invited to set their own and neither is needed. Password fields are also not required when the username's domain is configured for external authentication.

The username must be an email address unless `roleId` is a data-collector role. The role assigned cannot be higher than the calling user's own role.

Note that a request whose `username` key is **absent or null** currently fails with a 500 rather than the 400 below; the 400 is returned when `username` is present but blank.

put.description:
Updates multiple users from a CSV file upload.

**Request parts** (`multipart/form-data`): a single part named **`file`** containing the CSV. Only the `file` part is rendered below — the generator cannot yet publish multipart schemas.

**Required column:** `username`. **Optional columns:** `roleId`, `password`, `confirmPassword` — each row must carry at least one of `roleId` or `password`, and `confirmPassword` is required whenever `password` is present.

By default a row whose username does not exist fails. Set **`upsert=true`** to create those users instead, in which case the row must also satisfy the create rules (`roleId`, and a password unless the user is invited to set their own).

parameters.name: upsert
parameters.description: If true, creates users that don't exist.

requestBody.description: CSV file of user updates. See the description for the required and optional columns.

200.description: OK - Per-row results: which users were updated or created and which rows failed, with the reason

400.description: Bad Request - The file is missing, unparseable as CSV, missing the username column, over the per-request user limit set by the licence, over the file-size or row limits, or containing no rows that map to a valid user

post.summary: Bulk create users from CSV file
post.description:
Creates multiple users from a CSV file upload.

**Request parts** (`multipart/form-data`): a single part named **`file`** containing the CSV. Only the `file` part is rendered below — the generator cannot yet publish multipart schemas.

**Required columns:** `username`, `roleId`. **Optional columns:** `passwordOption`, `password`, `confirmPassword`, `includePasswordInEmail` — same meaning and same rules as the single-user create body.

Each row is validated independently; the response reports per-row successes and failures rather than failing the whole upload.

requestBody.description: CSV file of users to create. See the description for the required and optional columns.

200.description: OK - Per-row results: which users were created and which rows failed, with the reason

400.description: Bad Request - The file is missing, unparseable as CSV, missing a required column, over the per-request user limit set by the licence, over the file-size or row limits, or containing no rows that map to a valid user

put.description:
Updates multiple users from a JSON array.

Each element identifies the user by `username` (required) and carries the fields to change: at least one of `roleId` or `password`, with `confirmPassword` required whenever `password` is present. An empty array is rejected.

By default an element whose username does not exist fails. Set **`upsert=true`** to create those users instead, in which case the element must also satisfy the create rules.

parameters.name: upsert
parameters.description: If true, creates users that don't exist.

requestBody.description: The user updates. Each element is keyed by username.

200.description: OK - Per-element results: which users were updated or created and which failed, with the reason

400.description: Bad Request - Empty array, more elements than the per-request user limit set by the licence, or an element missing username or carrying nothing to update

error.message: User list cannot be empty

Each element has the same shape and the same required fields as the single-user create body: `username` and `roleId` are required, and the password fields follow `passwordOption`. An empty array is rejected.

Each element is validated independently; the response reports per-element successes and failures rather than failing the whole request.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: A custom role ID or a global/built-in role ID.

requestBody.description: The ID of the workflow profile to attach.

200.description: OK - Profile attached to the role

value.message: Workflow profile attached to role successfully.

400.description: Bad Request - Missing workflowProfileId in the request body

error.message: 'workflowProfileId' is required in the request body.

403.description: Forbidden - Workflow profiles feature disabled, or the caller lacks the Full Admin role

error.message: Workflow profiles feature is not enabled on this server.

404.description: Not Found - No workflow profile or role with the given ID

error.message: Workflow profile with id '99' does not exist.
Role with id 'unknown_role' does not exist.

delete.summary: Detach the workflow profile from a role
delete.description: Detaches the workflow profile from a role. Users with that role revert to the default Web Collect interface. Detaching a role that has no profile attached is a no-op and still succeeds.

parameters.name: roleId
parameters.description: A custom role ID or a global/built-in role ID.

200.description: OK - Profile detached from the role

value.message: Workflow profile detached from role successfully.

403.description: Forbidden - Workflow profiles feature disabled, or the caller lacks the Full Admin role

error.message: Workflow profiles feature is not enabled on this server.

404.description: Not Found - No role with the given ID

error.message: Role with id 'unknown_role' does not exist.

put.description: Updates an existing workflow profile. The name is always replaced by the request value. A description that is present replaces the stored one (send an empty string to clear it); an omitted or null description keeps the stored one. When a config is present it replaces the stored config whole (no merging), so include every setting you want to keep; when the config is omitted (or null), the previously stored config is kept unchanged. The version field is incremented by the server on every successful update.

parameters.description: The ID of the workflow profile to update.

requestBody.description: The new profile content. Same structure and validation as create.

get.summary: Download CSV data in long format
get.description: Downloads form data as CSV files in long format. Unlike wide format, long format does not truncate field data and maintains data integrity for large text fields. You can filter data by review status and optionally download as an attachment.

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form for which to download CSV data in long format.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of review statuses to filter the data. Valid values include: 'approved', 'rejected'.

parameters.name: dl
parameters.description: Optional flag to specify whether the file should be downloaded as an attachment.

400.description: Bad request - Invalid form ID, review status, or request parameters

404.description: Not found - Form does not exist

get.summary: Download CSV data for a specific repeat group
get.description: Downloads CSV data for a specific repeat group from a form in long format. This endpoint allows you to retrieve data for individual repeat groups. You can filter data by review status and optionally download as an attachment.

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form containing the repeat group for which to download CSV data.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of review statuses to filter the data. Valid values include: 'approved', 'rejected'.

parameters.name: dl
parameters.description: Optional flag to specify whether the file should be downloaded as an attachment.

parameters.name: repeatName
parameters.description: The name of the specific repeat group to download. This should match the repeat group name as defined in the form.

200.description: Successfully downloaded CSV file for the specified repeat group

400.description: Bad request - Invalid form ID, repeat group name, review status, or request parameters

404.description: Not found - Form or repeat group does not exist

get.summary: Download CSV data in wide format
get.description: Downloads form data as a CSV file in wide format. Wide format consolidates all data into a single file with repeat groups represented as separate columns. **Important:** Field data will be truncated at 16,384 characters in CSV wide format. For complete data, use long format, JSON format, or export via SurveyCTO Desktop. You can filter data by review status and optionally download as an attachment.

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form for which to download CSV data in wide format.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of review statuses to filter the data. Valid values include: 'approved', 'rejected'.

parameters.name: dl
parameters.description: Optional flag (query parameter) to specify whether the file should be downloaded as an attachment.

400.description: Bad request

404.description: Not found - Form does not exist

get.summary: Download JSON data in wide format
get.description: Downloads form submission data in wide JSON format. Supports filtering by review status, optional attachment download, and an optional exclusive lower bound on submission date (`date` query parameter).

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form.

parameters.name: r
parameters.description: Optional comma-separated list of review statuses to filter the data. Valid values include: 'approved', 'rejected'.

parameters.name: dl
parameters.description: Optional flag to specify whether the file should be downloaded as an attachment.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Optional exclusive lower bound on submission date for included rows (format as accepted by the server API date parser).

400.description: Bad request

404.description: Not found - Form does not exist

get.description: Returns a plain-text, newline-separated list of URLs for pre-generated CSV export files for the form (approved submissions). Each URL can be used to download the corresponding export.

parameters.name: formID
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the form.

400.description: Bad request

404.description: Not found - Form does not exist

post.description: Sets the server-wide CSV line break replacement value used when generating CSV exports via the API. Pass the new value in the `v` query parameter.

parameters.name: v
parameters.description: The line break replacement value to store (e.g. a space or empty string).

200.description: Line break setting updated or unchanged

400.description: Bad request - Missing or invalid value

delete.description: Removes the server-wide CSV line break replacement setting and purges cached API data files so subsequent exports use the default behavior.

200.description: Line break setting deleted or was already unset

save_form_label.description: Translated label for the "Save" button. Null = fall through to the base config.

pinned_forms_label.description: Translated label for the "Forms" (pinned forms) menu entry. Null = fall through to the base config.

home_label.description: Translated label for the "Home" / "Main page" link. Null = fall through to the base config.

custom_items.description: Per-item label translations, matched by the stable id of the corresponding item in the base form_header_config.custom_items.

FormHeaderConfigLabels.description: Label-only subset of form_header_config used inside locale_overrides: translated header/drawer labels and custom item labels. All fields are optional; omitted fields keep their defaults.

color_primary_hover.description: Hover/active state of the primary color. Default: #035a8c.

color_navbar_hover.description: Background of a navbar item on hover or while its dropdown is open. Default: #2EA3CF.

color_navbar_hover_text.description: Text color of a navbar item on hover or while its dropdown is open. Default: #FFFFFF.

color_surface.description: Card, panel, and modal surfaces. Default: #FFFFFF.

color_primary.description: Primary accent color: buttons, links, header-page background. Default: #047CC2.

color_link.description: Hyperlink color, also used for the active navbar item's text. Default: #2EA3CF.

color_danger_hover.description: Hover/active state of the destructive-action color. Default: #c9302c.

color_danger.description: Destructive-action buttons (for example Delete Saved Form): background and border. Default: #d9534f.

color_table_row_hover.description: Row hover background in the cases table and saved-forms lists. Default: #f5f5f5.

color_navbar_text.description: Navbar text and link color. Default: follows color_text unless set here.

ThemeConfig.description: Color scheme overrides applied across all Collect pages (main menu, form filling, cases, saved forms, delete pages). All fields optional; only non-null values are applied. Values must be valid CSS colors: hex, rgb(...), rgba(...), or a named color.

description.example: Simplified interface for field data collectors

id.description: Server-assigned profile ID. Use it in /{id} URLs and when attaching the profile to roles.

version.description: Starts at 1 and is incremented by the server on every successful update. Read-only.

WorkflowProfileOutput.description: A workflow profile as returned by the API.

layout.description: Layout mode for the main menu page: "default" (vertical buttons), "header_bar" (horizontal links in the top navbar; hides the colored header bar), or "custom" (replace default items with custom_items). Null = "default".

show_fill_blank_form.description: Show the "Fill Blank Form" button. Default: true.

show_edit_saved_form.description: Show the "Edit Saved Form" button. Default: true.

show_manage_cases.description: Show the "Manage Cases" button (only shown if cases are enabled on the server). Default: true.

delete_saved_form_label.description: Custom label for the "Delete Saved Form" button. Null = system default (i18n).

manage_cases_label.description: Custom label for the "Manage Cases" button. Null = system default (i18n).

fill_blank_form_label.description: Custom label for the "Fill Blank Form" button. Null = system default (i18n).

show_delete_saved_form.description: Show the "Delete Saved Form" button. Default: true.

edit_saved_form_label.description: Custom label for the "Edit Saved Form" button. Null = system default (i18n).

custom_items.description: Custom menu items. In "custom" layout they replace the default items; in "header_bar" layout they are appended after the defaults.

MenuConfig.description: Main menu configuration: which buttons appear on the Collect main menu page, their layout, custom labels, and optional custom items.

otherUserCode.description: Require users to enter a manager override code to view or select enumerators that aren't explicitly available to their username. Leave blank to allow all usernames to view or select all enumerators.

showFinalizedSentWhenTree.description: Whether to show finalized/sent cases when using tree view

enumeratorDatasetId.description: ID of the enumerator dataset used to filter the case list.

showColumnsWhenTable.description: List of column names to display when using table view. Only applicable when displayMode is 'table'

displayMode.description: Display mode for cases - either 'tree' or 'table' view

open_in_new_tab.description: Per-item override for the link target behavior. When omitted (null), inherits the global open_links_in_new_tab setting; when true or false, overrides it for this item only.

icon.description: FontAwesome icon class name matching fa-<name>. Optional.

form_id.description: Form ID to link to. Required when type is "form", ignored otherwise.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the list. Optional in general, but required to translate this item's label via locale_overrides (which references items by id, not position).

page.description: Standard Collect page name. Required when type is "page", ignored otherwise.

type.description: Item type: "form" (link to fill a form), "link" (URL), or "page" (standard Collect page). Required on every custom item.

url.description: URL to link to. Required when type is "link". Either a relative path starting with '/' or an absolute 'https://' URL. Plaintext http, protocol-relative URLs and other schemes are rejected. Validated whenever present, whatever the type.

CustomMenuItem.description: A custom menu/navigation item, used by both menu_config.custom_items and form_header_config.custom_items. Only type is always required; formId, url and page are each required for the matching type. All other fields are optional.

show_metadata.description: Show form metadata (form ID, version) alongside form titles. Default: true.

FormListConfig.description: Form list display options for the Manage Cases and form listing pages. All fields are optional; omitted fields keep their defaults.

empty_cases_message.description: Custom message shown when there are no cases to display (on cases pages). Null = system default.
empty_cases_message.example: No households assigned. Please check with your supervisor.

empty_forms_message.description: Custom message shown when there are no saved forms to display (on instances pages). Null = system default.
empty_forms_message.example: No forms are available for you right now.

main_menu_message.description: Intro/landing message displayed at the top of the main menu page, below the logo and subtitle. Plain text.
main_menu_message.example: Welcome! Please select a form below to begin.

main_menu_subtitle.description: Custom subtitle for the main menu page. Replaces the default "Secure, high-quality data collection" text.

UiMessages.description: Custom UI messages: empty-state messages and main menu landing text. All fields are optional; null fields use the system defaults.

password.description: Initial password. Required when passwordOption is "SET_NOW" (including when passwordOption is omitted), unless the username's domain is configured for external authentication. Must satisfy the server's password requirements.

roleId.description: The role to assign. Required when creating a user; on a bulk edit supply it only to change the role, where at least one of roleId or password must be present. Must be an existing role, and no higher than the calling user's own role (403 otherwise); only an administrator can create an administrator.

includePasswordInEmail.description: Whether to include the password in the account email sent to the new user. Default: false.

confirmPassword.description: Repeat of password, required whenever password is required. Must match password exactly.

username.description: The username to create. Must be an email address unless roleId is a data-collector role, and must not already exist on the server (409 otherwise).

UserInput.description: A user in a create or bulk-edit request. This one schema serves POST /api/v2/users, the bulk create endpoints, and the bulk edit endpoints, so only username is required on every one of them. On the create paths roleId is required as well, and password/confirmPassword follow passwordOption; on the bulk edit paths supply only the fields you want to change, with at least one of password or roleId present. Each operation's description states its own rules.

DatasetRecordFieldMap.description: Object whose keys are dataset field names and values are the corresponding string values for one record.

delete_saved_form_label.description: Translated label for the "Delete Saved Form" button. Null = fall through to the base config.

manage_cases_label.description: Translated label for the "Manage Cases" button. Null = fall through to the base config.

fill_blank_form_label.description: Translated label for the "Fill Blank Form" button. Null = fall through to the base config.

edit_saved_form_label.description: Translated label for the "Edit Saved Form" button. Null = fall through to the base config.

custom_items.description: Per-item label translations, matched by the stable id of the corresponding item in the base menu_config.custom_items.

MenuConfigLabels.description: Label-only subset of menu_config used inside locale_overrides: translated menu button labels and custom item labels. All fields are optional; omitted fields keep their defaults.

parentGroupId.description: ID of the parent group where this dataset will be positioned

LocationContext.description: Context for positioning the dataset within the group hierarchy and relative to other items

skip_welcome_page.description: Override the global skip_welcome_page for this form. Null = inherit.

hide_finalize_checkbox.description: Override the global hide_finalize_checkbox for this form. Null = inherit.

hide_instance_name.description: Override the global hide_instance_name for this form. Null = inherit.

pinned_forms.description: Override the global pinned_forms while this form is being filled. Null (or omitted) inherits the global list; an empty list explicitly shows no pinned forms for this form.

post_submit_form_id.description: Override the global post_submit_form_id for this form. Must be a valid SurveyCTO form ID. Null = inherit.

post_submit_url.description: Override the global post_submit_url for this form. Either a relative path starting with '/' or an absolute https URL, which may point outside this server. Null = inherit.

auto_send.description: Override the global auto_send for this form. Null = inherit.

FormFillingOverride.description: Per-form override of form_filling_config settings. All fields are nullable: null (or omitted) means "inherit the global default".

DatasetStatus.description:
**Possible values:**

* **READY**: Dataset is ready for use, all data is synchronized and up-to-date
* **DIRTY**: Dataset is currently being synchronized, data may be incomplete or in transition
x-enum-descriptions: * **READY**: Dataset is ready for use, all data is synchronized and up-to-date
* **DIRTY**: Dataset is currently being synchronized, data may be incomplete or in transition

locale_overrides.description: Per-language translations of profile strings. Keys are browser-language codes (e.g. "fr", "es", "hi") or admin-uploaded translation-table basenames; values are partial overlays -- only non-null fields replace the top-level defaults. An override section is applied only when the corresponding base section is present in the profile.

collect_entry_url.description: Landing page when the user navigates to /collect. Either a relative path starting with '/' or an absolute https URL, which may point outside this server. Protocol-relative URLs ('//host/...') and any other scheme are rejected. Null or blank = default main menu (/collect/main.html).

open_links_in_new_tab.description: Global default for whether links (form fill-out buttons, pinned forms, custom menu items) open in a new browser tab. Individual custom items can override this via their own open_in_new_tab field. Default: true.

WorkflowProfileConfig.description: Workflow profile configuration. All sections and fields are optional; omitted sections/fields use their defaults (everything visible, no custom labels, messages, or theme).

prefix.description: Prefix to be added at the beginning of the generated ID

allowCapitalLetters.description: Whether to allow capital letters in the generated ID

suffix.description: Suffix to be added at the end of the generated ID

numberOfDigits.description: Number of digits to include in the generated ID

IdFormatOptions.description: Configuration options for ID format used in auto-generation of enumerator IDs

id.description: Unique identifier of the item to use as a positioning reference

ContextItem.description: Reference to an item in the group hierarchy used for relative positioning

LocaleOverride.description: Per-language partial overlay of translatable profile strings. Only non-null fields replace the top-level defaults; each section is applied only when present in the base config.

save_form_label.description: Custom label for the "Save" button. Null = system default.

pinned_forms_icon.description: Custom FontAwesome icon for the pinned forms entry. Must be a plain FontAwesome class name matching fa-<name>.

pinned_forms_label.description: Custom label for the "Forms" (pinned forms) menu entry and modal title. Null = system default.

show_options_button.description: Show the "Options" dropdown menu. Default: true.

home_label.description: Custom label for the "Home" breadcrumb (next to the logo) and the drawer's "Main page" link. Null = system default.

show_save_form_button.description: Show the "Save Form" button in the drawer menu and navbar. Default: true.

show_home_link.description: Show the "Home" breadcrumb (next to the logo) and the form screen's "Main page" drawer entry. When false, only those two links are hidden -- the Exit/Return links and the post-exit redirects still navigate back to the main menu. Only meaningful while a profile is attached. Default: true.

show_languages.description: Show the language selector. Default: true.

custom_items.description: Custom navigation items shown in the form-filling drawer and navbar alongside built-in items (before the pinned-forms entry). Same structure as menu_config.custom_items.

main_page_url.description: Target of the "Home" / "Main page" link in the header. A relative path starting with '/' or an absolute https URL. Null = Collect main menu.

FormHeaderConfig.description: Form-filling header/navbar configuration: button visibility, label overrides, and custom navigation items. Form-filling behavior settings (auto-send, skip welcome, etc.) are in form_filling_config. All fields are optional; omitted fields keep their defaults.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for retrieving the next page. If null, there are no more pages available.

total.description: Total number of items available across all pages

data.description: Array of data items for the current page

limit.description: Page size limit for pagination. Maximum allowed is 1000 items per request.

CursorPaginatedResponse.description: Generic paginated response using cursor-based pagination for efficient data retrieval

name.description: Profile name. Trimmed; must be non-blank, at most 255 characters, and unique across the server.

description.description: Optional description. Trimmed; at most 4096 characters.
description.example: Simplified interface for field data collectors

WorkflowProfileInput.description: Request body for creating or updating a workflow profile.

PasswordOption.description:
**Possible values:**

* **USER_SET_OWN**: Send the new user an invitation to choose their own password. No password is sent in this request.
* **SET_NOW**: Set the password in this request. Requires password and confirmPassword. This is the default when passwordOption is omitted.
x-enum-descriptions: * **USER_SET_OWN**: Send the new user an invitation to choose their own password. No password is sent in this request.
* **SET_NOW**: Set the password in this request. Requires password and confirmPassword. This is the default when passwordOption is omitted.

password.description: New password. Optional; when present, confirmPassword is required and must match. Must satisfy the server's password requirements.

roleId.description: New role. Optional; when present it must be an existing role and no higher than the calling user's own role.

confirmPassword.description: Repeat of the new password. Required when password is present, ignored otherwise.

UserUpdateInput.description: Request body for updating a user. Every field is individually optional, but at least one of password or roleId must be present — an otherwise empty body is rejected with 400.

totalRecords.description: Number of rows/records in the dataset

groupId.description: ID of the group that owns this dataset. Groups are used to organize and control access to datasets.

uniqueRecordField.description: Field name used for unique record identification

lastIncomingDataDate.description: Timestamp of the last incoming data

RecordSearchRequest.description: Optional search body with "filters" and/or "fields". Dataset search: filters on dataset columns plus optional modifiedAt filters; form submissions: filters only on submission metadata fields (see Forms operation descriptions).

skip_welcome_page.description: Skip the form's "Welcome" screen and land directly on the first question. Default: false.

hide_finalize_checkbox.description: Hide the "Mark form as finalized" checkbox; the form always submits as finalized. Default: false.

hide_instance_name.description: Hide the "Name this form" text input on the save-and-exit screen; the auto-generated instance name is used. Default: false.

pinned_forms.description: Form IDs to pin for quick access from the form-filling header/drawer. Pinned forms appear in a dedicated "Forms" menu item and modal while a form is being filled out. The form currently being filled is always excluded from its own pinned-forms menu. Can be overridden per form via form_overrides. Default: empty (no pinned forms).

post_submit_form_id.description: Form ID to navigate to after submission (the client navigates to /collect/{form_id}); the thank-you screen is skipped. Must be a valid SurveyCTO form ID.

post_submit_url.description: Where to navigate after submission: either a relative path starting with '/' or an absolute https URL, which may point outside this server. Protocol-relative URLs ('//host/...') and any other scheme are rejected. Used only when post_submit_form_id is not set.

form_overrides.description: Per-form overrides. Keys are form IDs; values may override any of the global settings for that form. Fields left out (or null) inherit the global value.

auto_send.description: Completely skip the save-and-exit screen: the form auto-submits as finalized with the auto-generated instance name. When true, hide_instance_name and hide_finalize_checkbox are irrelevant. Default: false.

FormFillingConfig.description: Form-filling behavior: welcome screen, submission flow, save-and-exit screen, and post-submission navigation. Settings apply globally; per-form overrides can be specified via form_overrides. All fields are optional; omitted fields keep their defaults.

errorMessages.description: List of error messages encountered during the upload

rowsAdded.description: Number of new records added to the dataset

rowsUpdated.description: Number of existing records updated in the dataset

valuesTruncated.description: Number of values that were truncated due to length constraints (maximum length is 255 characters)

enumeratorDatasetLinkedMessage.description: Message about enumerator dataset linking, if applicable

columnsAdded.description: Number of new columns added to the dataset

DatasetChanges.description: Summary of changes made to the dataset during the upload operation

allowOfflineUpdates.description: Whether the dataset allows offline updates.

id.description: Unique identifier for the dataset. Must be unique across the system.

uniqueRecordField.description: Field name to use for unique record identification.

DatasetInput.description: Input model for creating and updating datasets with all required configuration options

id.description: The id of the custom item in the base config this translation applies to. Must match an existing item id.

label.description: The translated display text for the item.

CustomItemLabelOverride.description: Translated label for one custom item, referenced by the item's stable id in the base config's custom_items list. Only the label can be translated; the item structure stays the same.
